Hydrogen ions are formed when an acid releases a proton (H⁺) by ionizing in water, for example HCl → H⁺ + Cl⁻. Neither option in the team note fits this. Phosphocreatine breakdown actually consumes H⁺ (PCr + ADP + H⁺ → Cr + ATP), and aerobic fat oxidation does not release significant H⁺.

CONFIDENCE: 60
